purpose: interactive inspection; not a performance benchmark
display: raw actor logits and softmax conditional on legal actions; value head is a global reward estimate
move_quality: exp(chosen logit - maximum legal logit), evaluated before each move; policy agreement, not objective optimality
activations: CPU forward-pass tensors; slots are tile-plus-position embeddings; encoder/actor/critic are post-GELU; h/c are after processing the current observation
